Your own Telegram folders come after these tabs. To add a chat to Favourites, press and hold it in the chat list, then ⋮ → Add to Favourites. The Favourites tab appears with its first chat.
Shows the person\'s or chat\'s ID next to their status. A scammer can change their name and photo in a second but never the ID, so a screenshot that shows it is evidence the account can be found by.
Remind me to set a cloud password
Anyone who gets the login code from your SMS can take over this account. A cloud password stops them: it is asked for after the code on every new device. Setting it up takes a minute.
